tagline: A community banking organization providing consumer and commercial financial services
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest income is the primary revenue driver for the company, reflecting its ability to manage the spread between interest income on assets and interest expenses on liabilities.

kpis.name: Net interest margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net interest income relative to interest-earning assets.
kpis.description: Net interest margin measures the profitability of a bank's lending and investment activities.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income represents the overall profitability of the company.

kpis.short: Net income available to common shareholders
kpis.name: Net income available to common shareholders
kpis.explanation: Net income remaining after preferred dividends are deducted.
kpis.description: Indicates the portion of earnings that can be distributed to common shareholders.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in earnings for common shareholders.

kpis.name: Return on average assets
kpis.explanation: Measures how efficiently a company uses its assets to generate profits.
kpis.description: A key indicator of operational performance and asset management.

kpis.short: Return on average common shareholders' equity
kpis.name: Return on average common shareholders' equity
kpis.explanation: Measures the return generated on common shareholders' equity investment.
kpis.description: Indicates how much profit a company generates per dollar of equity.

kpis.name: Efficiency ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures operating expenses as a percentage of revenue, indicating operational efficiency.
kpis.description: A lower ratio indicates better efficiency, as less revenue is spent on operations.

kpis.name: Net charge-offs to average loans
kpis.explanation: Percentage of loans deemed uncollectible after recoveries.
kpis.description: An indicator of the bank's credit risk.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in loan loss provisions.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.392 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Acquisition-related expenses
kpis.explanation: Direct costs incurred during a merger or acquisition.
kpis.description: These expenses are related to the integration of Blue Foundry.

risks.title: Dependence on Subsidiary Dividends
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on dividends and payments from its subsidiaries for virtually all of its revenue and its ability to pay dividends.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the risk factors, highlighting a critical dependency for revenue and distribution capacity. The language is direct and indicates substantial reliance. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks Related to the Blue Foundry Merger
risks.summary: The merger with Blue Foundry, although approved, presents risks related to integration, costs, and the realization of expected synergies.
risks.score_rationale: The merger is a major event detailed in the 'Management's Discussion' section. It involves integration costs and significant execution risks, directly impacting operations and finances. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit Risk and Potential Losses
risks.summary: The company is exposed to credit risk through its loan portfolio, requiring loss provisions based on complex estimates and economic factors.
risks.score_rationale: The allowance for credit losses and loan portfolio quality analysis are central to the financial discussion. The use of complex models (PD, LGD, EAD) and the influence of economic factors underscore this risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Market Performance and Banking Competition
risks.summary: The company's performance is influenced by banking market conditions and competition, potentially affecting its net interest margin and growth.
risks.score_rationale: Comparison with the Nasdaq Bank Index and the S&P 500, along with discussion on net interest margin (NIM), indicates sensitivity to market conditions and sector competition. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures
risks.summary: The use of non-GAAP financial measures, while common, may complicate analysis and potentially differ from investor perception.
risks.score_rationale: The 'Supplemental Reporting of Non-GAAP Based Financial Measures' section details the use of non-GAAP metrics. While justified by the company, this may introduce complexity and risk of misinterpretation for investors. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Management of Compensation Plans and Dilution
risks.summary: The management of employee stock and option plans, as well as share repurchase programs, may affect share dilution and shareholder value.
risks.score_rationale: Information on equity plans (RSU, PSU, ESPP) and share repurchase programs is detailed. The management of these plans can impact shareholder dilution and capital structure. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: FULT does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial, lending, investment, and operational aspects of the company, with no reference to AI or related technology.
